visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair and a straight fringe, wearing a teal-blue short-sleeved top and white frayed denim shorts, sits on a grey fabric couch. She holds a large blue box with 'Gundam Seed Freedom' artwork. Behind her, the setting includes pastel-colored pillows with cat drawings and framed piano-themed wall art. (2) The camera transitions to a sequence of product shots. A black box is opened to reveal white text detailing the 'G.U.N.D.A.M.' acronym. The girl is then seen holding two themed game controllers, one white with blue graphics and one deep red with white graphics, smiling warmly with a soft facial expression and clear skin. (3) Close-up macro shots focus on the controllers' hardware details. Fingers are shown manipulating the joysticks and buttons, which illuminate with bright blue LED lights. The surface textures and precise markings like 'ZGMF-X10A' and 'GameNIR' logos are clearly visible under bright, even studio lighting. (4) The woman is filmed from a back-side angle as she sits at a comprehensive gaming setup. She is playing a game using the white controller. The desk features three monitors, a pink mechanical keyboard, various figurines like Pikachu and Gengar, a professional microphone on a boom arm, and acoustic foam panels in the background. (5) A series of panning shots showcase the product line, including several hard-shell carrying cases in white, blue, black, and pink with 'Gundam Seed' branding. The lighting in this phase is more atmospheric, with neon blue and pink highlights reflecting off the metallic and plastic surfaces of the gear. (6) The final phase features the controllers mounted on glowing RGB charging bases that cycle through vibrant colors. The camera pans across the setup, emphasizing the integration of the controllers with their specialized docks against a dark, tech-focused background with stylized Gundam-themed graphics and text overlays.
